about_the_game:
In Frame Machina - OcularZero, your Frame’s ocular vision is damaged your only sight is the minimap. Ambushed and outnumbered, you must rely on instinct, precision, and awareness to survive an onslaught of relentless enemies. This is pure, high-speed arcade survival. No upgrades, no second chances, just you, your Frame, and the fight.

  • Blind Combat, Pure Instinct 

    With your Frame’s vision systems down, you can only perceive the battlefield through the minimap. Track enemies, react in real time, and fight without ever seeing them directly.

  • High-Speed, Precision Action

    Responsive controls let you weave through incoming fire, strafe past threats, and unleash devastation in every direction.

  • Relentless, Unforgiving Ambush

    Waves of enemies will hunt you down with aggression. There’s no escape only survival for as long as you can hold out.

No hand-holding. No mercy. Just pure skill. How long can you survive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10
  • Processor: 1.2GHz processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 8-compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A high-speed, hardcore arcade survival shooter where you pilot a mech completely blind to the battlefield. Your only sight? The minimap. With relentless waves of enemies closing in, precise movement, and total awareness are your only chances at survival. How long can you survive?
